raw_market.question: Bengals vs. Dolphins: 4Q O/U 5.5
raw_market.description:
In the fourth quarter of the NFL game between Bengals and Dolphins, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Bengals and Dolphins combine to score 6 or more points in the fourth quarter.

If the combined fourth quarter total is less than 6, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
